faqs.q: What are Embedded G-Fin Tubes used for?
faqs.a: Fin strip wound into a helical groove cut in the base tube, with the groove edges rolled back to lock the fin root. Embedded fins are the highest-temperature aluminium-fin type, so they go on the hot inlet passes of air coolers in refineries and gas plants. It is listed in 5 sizes, 15.88–38.1 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Embedded G-Fin Tubes, such as IH-TF-GF-GFN-0159?
faqs.a: Embedded G-Fin Tubes part numbers begin with IH-TF-GF-GFN and end in a size code: IH-TF-GF-GFN-0159 is the 15.88 mm OD size and IH-TF-GF-GFN-0381 is the 38.1 mm OD size. Quote the full part number from the size table, or give us the size and the load you need, when you enquire.

faqs.q: What sizes do Embedded G-Fin Tubes come in?
faqs.a: Embedded G-Fin Tubes are listed in 5 sizes, 15.88–38.1 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-GF-GFN-0159 and IH-TF-GF-GFN-0381. The table includes 15.88 mm OD by ≥2.11 mm wall and 38.1 mm OD by ≥2.11 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Embedded G-Fin Tubes to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Embedded G-Fin Tubes, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity, with the fin type, material, height. Thickness and fins per inch, and the bare length at each end. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What is the maximum service temperature of Embedded G-Fin Tubes?
faqs.a: The maximum service temperature for Embedded G-Fin Tubes: ≈400 °C typical maker limit (published 380–415 °C). Where a figure is not listed for a size, we confirm it on the quotation.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Embedded G-Fin Tubes?
faqs.a: For Embedded G-Fin Tubes, testing follows the governing standard: Base tube tests per its spec; Fin pull-out/bond check per maker QA. Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Embedded G-Fin Tubes available in?
faqs.a: Embedded G-Fin Tubes are available in these grades: Carbon steel A179, A192, SA210 A1/C, A106 B; Stainless TP304/304L, TP316/316L; Duplex S31803; Copper C12200, Cu-Ni 90/10, 70/30. The fin or coating material is Aluminium 1060/1100; Copper; Carbon steel.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Embedded G-Fin Tubes?
faqs.a: Embedded G-Fin Tubes are made to API 661 / ISO 13706, ASTM A179, ASTM A192, ASTM A210, ASTM A106 B. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Embedded G-Fin Tubes connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Embedded G-Fin Tubes, finned tubes are fitted in header boxes and carried at the tube supports, usually with support collars, so the fin outside diameter has to match the supports and headers. Related ranges are the [HF-Welded Spiral Fin Tubes](/c/hf-welded-spiral-fin-tubes) and [Wound Fin Tubes (L / LL / KL)](/c/wound-fin-tubes-l-ll-kl) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Embedded G-Fin Tubes be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Embedded G-Fin Tubes on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.a: Yes. We keep Embedded G-Fin Tubes in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send the part numbers and quantities through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
